records.name: Robert (R.J.) Hinde
records.priorTitle: Vice Provost for Academic Affairs / Associate Dean, College of Arts and Sciences (UT Knoxville, chemistry professor)
records.notes: Currently listed simply as 'Executive Dean' (no interim qualifier). Named interim executive dean effective Nov. 1, 2022, replacing Theresa Lee as she prepared to retire; title has since been carried without an 'interim' designation on the college's official leadership page. See also https://utdailybeacon.com/81954/campus-news/professor-rj-hinde-named-interim-dean-of-college-of-arts-and-sciences/

records.name: Theresa Lee
records.priorTitle: Chair, Department of Psychology
records.notes: Named dean in 2011, began Jan. 1, 2012, as the Herbert Family Dean. Stepped down June 30, 2023 after 11 years leading the college.

records.name: Bruce Bursten
records.priorTitle: Chemistry department administrator/professor (prior institution not confirmed in currently accessible sources)
records.notes: UT News announced Bursten as the new Arts and Sciences dean in May 2005; the original article is no longer reachable (404), so this entry is based on the indexed headline and a 2011 UT News piece on the search for his successor, which places his departure around 2011.

records.name: Daniel Brinks
records.priorTitle: Associate Dean, College of Liberal Arts
records.notes: Appointed interim dean effective Aug. 20, 2026, succeeding David Sosa; expected to serve until August 2027 while a permanent search continues. Chaired the advisory committee that restructured the college under Sosa.

records.name: David Sosa
records.priorTitle: Chair, Department of Philosophy (Louann and Larry Temple Centennial Professor in the Humanities)
records.notes: Named interim dean effective June 1, 2025, after Ann Huff Stevens' term ended; oversaw consolidation of ethnic and gender studies programs into the Department of Social and Cultural Analysis. Succeeded by Daniel Brinks in August 2026.

records.name: Ann Huff Stevens
records.priorTitle: Chair, Department of Economics; Founding Director, Center for Poverty Research
records.notes: Began as dean July 15, 2019. Denied a second term by President Jay Hartzell in 2024; her term ended in August 2025. Later named provost of the University of Colorado Boulder, effective July 2025. See also https://www.statesman.com/story/news/education/2024/10/02/university-of-texas-dean-says-jay-hartzell-wont-let-her-seek-second-term/75488355007/

records.name: Randy Diehl
records.priorTitle: Chair, Department of Psychology
records.notes: Served as dean of the College of Liberal Arts from 2007 until retiring in 2019, when Ann Huff Stevens succeeded him.

records.name: Simon North
records.priorTitle: Interim Dean (from Sept. 2025); Executive Associate Dean, College of Arts and Sciences (from June 2024); Head, Department of Chemistry (from 2016)
records.notes: Named interim dean of the College of Arts and Sciences (the college's current name, formerly College of Liberal Arts) in September 2025 after Mark Zoran's removal, then appointed permanent dean effective June 1, 2026. See also https://wtaw.com/texas-am-announces-a-new-dean-of-the-college-of-arts-and-sciences/

records.name: Mark Zoran
records.priorTitle: Not confirmed in available sources
records.notes: Removed as dean effective immediately in September 2025 by President Gen. Mark A. Welsh III, alongside an English department head, following the viral-video controversy over a children's-literature course lecture on gender identity. His exact appointment start year could not be confirmed; his Texas A&M faculty profile page has since been taken down (HTTP 410).

records.name: Pamela R. Matthews
records.priorTitle: Interim Dean, College of Liberal Arts (since July 2014); Associate Dean for Undergraduate Programs; Associate Provost for Undergraduate Studies
records.notes: Named permanent dean in April 2015 after serving as interim dean since July 2014; a professor of English who joined Texas A&M in 1989. Her exact end date and whether Mark Zoran succeeded her directly could not be confirmed with available sources.

records.name: Tosha Dupras
records.priorTitle: Professor of Anthropology; Department Chair; Associate/Senior Associate Dean of Faculty and Graduate Education
records.notes: Appointment announced Jan. 7, 2022; began serving as dean June 1, 2022, after 23 years at the University of Central Florida. Predecessor information could not be confirmed from currently accessible Texas Tech sources.

records.name: Brian T. Edwards
records.priorTitle: Crown Professor in Middle East Studies, Professor of English and Comparative Literary Studies, Founding Director of the Program in Middle East and North African Studies
records.notes: Joined Tulane in 2018 as dean of the School of Liberal Arts, the largest of Tulane's schools, overseeing 17 departments and 15 programs.

records.name: Carole Haber
records.priorTitle: Professor of History
records.notes: Hired in July 2008 to lead the newly reorganized School of Liberal Arts (created as part of Tulane's post-Katrina Renewal Plan); served a decade as dean, described as a 'transformative' tenure. Predecessor (if any distinct dean led the school 2005-2008) could not be confirmed.

seats.school: Kendall College of Arts and Sciences

records.name: Blaine Greteman
records.priorTitle: Professor and Chair, Department of English
records.notes: Began as dean July 1, 2024. A Rhodes Scholar and Shakespeare/Milton scholar; succeeded interim dean Kirsten Olds.

records.name: Kirsten Olds
records.priorTitle: Faculty member, Kendall College of Arts and Sciences
records.notes: Served as interim dean following Karen Petersen's spring 2023 departure to become president of Hendrix College, until Blaine Greteman's arrival in July 2024.

records.name: Karen K. Petersen
records.priorTitle: Dean, College of Liberal Arts
records.notes: Assumed duties Feb. 1, 2021, succeeding Kalpana Misra. Left in spring 2023 to become the 13th president of Hendrix College.

records.name: Kalpana Misra
records.priorTitle: Not specified in available sources
records.notes: Served as dean since 2013 before stepping down in 2021 and returning to the faculty after a sabbatical.

records.name: Bárbara M. Brizuela
records.priorTitle: Professor, Department of Education; Dean ad interim, School of Arts and Sciences (from July 2024)
records.notes: Named dean ad interim in July 2024 after James Glaser's departure, then formally appointed as the 18th dean of the School of Arts and Sciences in November 2024. See also https://now.tufts.edu/2024/05/07/school-arts-and-sciences-interim-dean-named

records.name: James M. Glaser
records.priorTitle: Professor, Department of Political Science
records.notes: Departed at the end of the 2023-24 academic year to become provost and executive vice president of Santa Clara University.

records.name: Joanne Berger-Sweeney
records.priorTitle: Professor, Department of Biology
records.notes: Later became president of Trinity College (Hartford, CT) in 2014.

records.name: Robert Sternberg
records.priorTitle: IBM Professor of Psychology and Education
records.notes: Prior institution per general biographical record; Tufts' official deans list confirms his 2005-2010 tenure but does not itemize his pre-Tufts title.

records.name: Wanda S. Pillow
records.priorTitle: Acting Dean, College of Humanities (from Oct. 2024); Associate Dean for Academic Affairs and Chair, Gender Studies Division, School for Cultural and Social Transformation
records.notes: Named permanent dean of both the College of Humanities and the School for Cultural and Social Transformation in March 2025, after serving as acting dean since October 2024.

records.name: Hollis Robbins
records.priorTitle: Dean, School of Arts and Humanities
records.notes: Announced December 2021, began July 1, 2022. Previously chaired the Department of Humanities at the Peabody Institute, Johns Hopkins University. Departed by October 2024 when Pillow became acting dean.

records.name: Stuart K. Culver
records.priorTitle: Acting/Interim Dean, College of Humanities; Associate Professor of English
records.notes: Moved from acting/interim dean into the permanent role in 2018; returned to teaching and research when Hollis Robbins arrived in 2022.

records.name: Robert D. Newman
records.priorTitle: Professor of English
records.notes: Left the deanship in September 2014 to become president and director of the National Humanities Center. His start year as dean and any intervening dean(s) before Stuart Culver's 2018 appointment could not be confirmed from available sources.

records.name: Jason Merchant
records.priorTitle: Vice Provost for Academic Affairs; Lorna P. Straus Distinguished Service Professor of Linguistics
records.notes: Named the Searcy Family Dean of the College of Arts and Science, beginning July 1, 2026, succeeding Timothy McNamara.

records.name: Timothy P. McNamara
records.priorTitle: Professor of Psychology (cognitive scientist)
records.notes: Appointed the Searcy Family Dean in 2023; announced his decision to step down at the end of his term, returning to the faculty June 30, 2026. Oversaw record fundraising and a new Arts and Science College Core curriculum.

records.name: John Geer
records.priorTitle: Professor of Political Science
records.notes: Named dean of the College of Arts and Science in 2018, described as a 'political scientist and strategic leader,' succeeding Lauren Benton.

records.name: Lauren Benton
records.priorTitle: Professor of History (10-year tenure, including dean roles)
records.notes: Joined Vanderbilt as dean in July 2015 after a decade in leadership and faculty roles at NYU; stepped down as dean in December 2017.

seats.school: College and Graduate School of Arts and Sciences

records.name: Christa D. Acampora
records.priorTitle: Deputy Provost; Professor of Philosophy
records.notes: Effective Sept. 1, 2022, succeeding Ian Baucom (who became UVA provost); David Hill briefly served as interim dean from March 1, 2022 until Acampora's arrival.

records.name: Ian Baucom
records.priorTitle: Professor, Department of English (17 years on faculty)
records.notes: Began July 1, 2014, as the Buckner W. Clay Dean of the College and Graduate School of Arts & Sciences; served eight years before becoming UVA provost in 2022.

records.name: Meredith Jung-En Woo
records.priorTitle: Not specified in available sources
records.notes: Became dean June 1, 2008, succeeding interim dean Karen L. Ryan, who had led the college after Edward Ayers departed to become president of the University of Richmond in mid-2007.
